description_en: Starts the channel of a change tracking instance. This is a legacy operation
description_zh: 老版启动订阅数据订阅实例通道
kebab_example: aliyun dts start-subscription-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtso6m11cxt26q0000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartSubscriptionInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
